description: Step 2 — Core leak closure: checkLanguageModelAccess, team-scoped list filtering (ADMIN=GSI3 all, others=GSI1 per team, intersected with Transcribe COMPLETED, PENDING excluded), and job-usage team check on start-transcription with ADMIN cross-team audit flag. Depends on FEAT-001 (repository + metadata + types). Treat the current absence of a job-usage team check and the unrestricted list as CONFIRMED leaks and prove closure with tests; do not assume already-handled.
steps: Add checkLanguageModelAccess(user, modelName): Promise<LanguageModelMetadata> to <WT>/backend/src/services/access-control-service.ts: load via getModel; if missing or deletionStatus==='PENDING' -> denyResourceAccess() (404); if isAdmin(user) return it; else if model.teamId in await getUserTeamIds(user.userId) return it; else denyResourceAccess(). Add cases to access-control-service.test.ts.

Change listModels in <WT>/backend/src/services/language-model-service.ts to accept user: AuthUser: ADMIN -> queryAll() (GSI3); others -> union of queryByTeam(teamId) over getUserTeamIds. Exclude deletionStatus 'PENDING'. Fetch Transcribe ListLanguageModels, keep only COMPLETED, return only models present in BOTH sets (match by modelName). Response items include modelName, displayName, teamId, modelStatus (and baseModelName/createTime if available). Update <WT>/backend/src/handlers/list-language-models.ts to pass user. Update list-language-models.test.ts + language-model-service.test.ts.

Add property test 'Feature: language-model-team-isolation, Property N: team-scoped list filtering' in language-model-service.property.test.ts, docstring **Validates: Requirements 18.4**: non-ADMIN sees exactly (teamId in caller teams) intersect (Transcribe COMPLETED) and never a PENDING model; ADMIN sees all COMPLETED.

Change startJob in <WT>/backend/src/services/transcription-job-service.ts to accept user: AuthUser. When languageModelName provided, call checkLanguageModelAccess(user, languageModelName) (404 on violation). Record a job-start audit log via recordAuditLog with metadata.languageModelName, and when isAdmin(user) and model.teamId not in getUserTeamIds(user.userId) add metadata.crossTeamModelUsage: true (verify whether a job-start audit already exists; extend it or add one). Update <WT>/backend/src/handlers/start-transcription.ts to pass the full user object. Update transcription-job-service.test.ts + start-transcription.test.ts, incl. a test proving an other-team model name yields 404.
acceptance_criteria: A non-ADMIN caller's GET /language-models returns only models whose teamId is in the caller's teams AND are COMPLETED in Transcribe, excluding PENDING; ADMIN returns all COMPLETED.
start-transcription with a languageModelName the caller cannot access returns 404 (denyResourceAccess).
When ADMIN starts a job with a model from a team they do not belong to, the job-start audit metadata carries languageModelName and crossTeamModelUsage: true.
findings: CONFIRMED LEAKS CLOSED: (1) listModels was unrestricted (Transcribe-only, COMPLETED filter, no team scope) -> now team-scoped. (2) startJob had NO job-usage team check and NO job-start audit log at all -> both added. SIGNATURE CHANGES (breaking, later FEATs must follow): listModels now takes (user: AuthUser) and returns LanguageModelSummary[] where each item adds optional displayName+teamId (modelName/modelStatus/baseModelName/createTime unchanged). StartJobParams.userId REMOVED; now takes user: AuthUser (handler passes the full extractUser result). NEW EXPORT: access-control-service.ts checkLanguageModelAccess(user, modelName): Promise<LanguageModelMetadata> -> getModel; missing OR deletionStatus==='PENDING' => denyResourceAccess() 404; ADMIN returns metadata; else teamId in getUserTeamIds(user.userId) returns metadata; else 404. access-control-service.ts now imports getModel from language-model-repository + LanguageModelMetadata type. LISTMODELS SEMANTICS: ADMIN => queryAll() (GSI3); non-ADMIN => union of queryByTeam(teamId) over getUserTeamIds (empty teams => empty list, queryByTeam not called); PENDING metadata excluded; de-duped by modelName; intersected with Transcribe ListLanguageModels filtered to COMPLETED (filterCompletedModels); only models present in BOTH sets returned, matched by modelName; createTime/modelStatus come from Transcribe, displayName/teamId from metadata (added internal helper loadVisibleMetadata). JOB-START AUDIT: startJob now, when languageModelName set, calls checkLanguageModelAccess (404 before any Transcribe/DynamoDB write) and records a NEW audit log operationType 'TRANSCRIPTION_JOB_STARTED' (resourceType 'TranscriptionJob', resourceId=jobId) with metadata.mediaFileId+transcribeJobName, metadata.languageModelName when a model is used, and metadata.crossTeamModelUsage:true only when isAdmin(user) AND model.teamId NOT in getUserTeamIds(user.userId). The audit log is recorded for EVERY job start (model or not); no prior job-start audit existed. NEW AUDIT OPERATION TYPE 'TRANSCRIPTION_JOB_STARTED' added to BOTH unions (types/index.ts + repositories/audit-repository.ts), to handlers/audit-logs.ts VALID_OPERATION_TYPES, and to audit-service.property.test.ts operationTypeArb (kept in sync). TESTS: added checkLanguageModelAccess cases (ADMIN/member/other-team 404/missing 404/PENDING 404) to access-control-service.test.ts (mocks language-model-repository getModel); rewrote listModels tests (ADMIN/non-ADMIN/PENDING-exclusion/no-team) in language-model-service.test.ts; updated transcription-job-service.test.ts (startJob now user:AuthUser; mocks access-control-service checkLanguageModelAccess+getUserTeamIds and audit-service recordAuditLog; added model-access-enforced, no-model-no-check, OTHER-TEAM 404 (proves no job start/save), audit-with/without-languageModelName, ADMIN cross-team flag true, ADMIN own-team no-flag); updated start-transcription.test.ts expected startJob args (user object); added property test Property 4 'team-scoped list filtering' (**Validates: Requirements 18.4**, numRuns 100) in language-model-service.property.test.ts proving non-ADMIN sees exactly (teamId in caller teams) ∩ COMPLETED and never PENDING, ADMIN sees all ACTIVE+COMPLETED. VERIFICATION: cd backend && npx vitest --run => 1188 passed / 85 skipped, 0 failed.
